SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DISTINCT BUYER, PO_NO FROM ICOMPODT A WHERE (BUYER, PO_NO) IN ( SELECT TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS PO_NO FROM ICOMTRXL A WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO_DOWN' AND TARGET = 'KRILJI0001' AND KEY_9 = ' ' ) AND STATUS IN ('C','R') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PR_NO = A.PR_NO AND PR_SEQ = A.PR_SEQ AND PO_NO != A.PO_NO ) ORDER BY BUYER, PO_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ, A.STATUS, A.ADD_DATE, A.ADD_TIME, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.ITEM_QTY, A.UNIT_PRICE, A.ITEM_AMT, A.RD_DATE, A.MAKER_CODE, A.MAKER_NAME, A.DELY_TO_LOCATION, A.PR_NO, A.PR_SEQ, A.REF_PR_NO, A.PO_REMARK, A.REF_IF_NO, A.PLANT, A.REF_PR_NO AS PRODUCT_CODE, B.REQ_DEPT AS BUDGET_DEPT, B.ACCOUNT_TYPE, C.LEGACY_USER_ID AS EMPLOYEE_NUMBER FROM ICOMPODT A INNER JOIN ICOMPRDT B ON (1 = 1 AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PR_NO = A.PR_NO AND B.PR_SEQ = A.PR_SEQ ) INNER JOIN ICOMLUSR C ON (1 = 1 AND C.USER_ID = B.REQ_USER_ID ) WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'T', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO_DOWN' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND KEY_9 = ' '
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'E', KEY_10 = 'PODT ERROR' WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO_DOWN' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND KEY_9 = ' '
